sounds.description: Console. A short, soft electronic blip (80 to 120 ms), like a 1960s telemetry readout updating: mid-high pitch, clean, no reverb. 3 or 4 takes, slightly different in pitch, so the repetition doesn't show. Plays every 2 s while a camera is live, and stops once telemetry is lost.

Console. An attention tone, not an alarm (at most 0.25 s): two quick alternating notes, a soft warble. Plays when the CAUTION lamp lights: once after a glitch, three times with the lamp's flashes when the controllers save one.

Console. A harsh, urgent alarm pulse in the manner of Apollo's master alarm, cut as a seamless loop of about 0.6 s. Plays from the reveal of a failure or a catastrophic failure for 3 s, then stops while the lamp stays lit. OGG, for a seamless loop.
Console. Soft radio static with a faint crackle, a seamless loop of 3 to 5 s. Very quiet: it plays under every step without a clip of its own, which is most steps for now. OGG, for a seamless loop.
Console. A dry mechanical click (about 50 ms): a relay or a toggle switch. Plays on Play and Pause, as the HOLD lamp goes on or off.

Background music, several tracks of 1 to 2 minutes, played shuffled with no repeats while a replay is open. Space opera, but generic enough for any step: no big climax, nothing triumphant or tragic that could hint at a result, an ending that doesn't jar when the next track starts. OGG or MP3.

Mission control's room: air-conditioning hum, distant indistinct voices, now and then a chair or paper; no words anyone could make out. A seamless loop of 30 to 60 s under the music, the whole replay long. OGG, for a seamless loop.
